recipes.name: Best Meatloaf in the Whole Wide World!

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine ketchup, brown sugar, bacon bits, pineapple, and 1 dash Worcestershire sauce in a small bowl; set aside.
Combine ground beef, bread crumbs, saltines, onion, egg, salt, garlic, black pepper, and remaining 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce in a large bowl; mix well. Pat into a 9x5-inch loaf pan.

Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven; pour pineapple mixture over loaf. Continue baking until no longer pink in the center, about 20 minutes more. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Best Meatloaf in the Whole Wide World!
raw_recipe.description: This is the best meatloaf in the whole wide world. A pineapple-bacon sauce bakes into a ground beef mixture, creating a sweet, smoky, savory meatloaf.

review.reviewBody: This was an absolute hit in our house - followed recipe exactly and wouldn't change a thing!! Thanks for posting

I have no idea how i can mess up a simple meatloaf recipe but for some reason, the texture of this meatloaf was unappealing. I, like the other reviewer added a lil pineapple to my meat mixture and thought maybe that had an effect on the texture. I dont know what else could have happened. It was almost unedible to be honest. Have no idea what went wrong. I will attempt this again just because im a lil baffled. On a positive note the sauce was AMAZING! A lil to sweet so i will cut back on sugar next time but other than that it was amazing. I used real bacon instead of the bits. If anything, i will continue to use the sauce for my meatload topping.

Out of the ballpark! Husband kept going back for seconds, thirds,... Until I made this my favorite meatloaf was the "Brown Sugar Meatloaf," which is delicious. But this one might have been even better! Not only scrumptious but has a great mouth feel and texture! 
I doubled the recipe. For the glaze, I used diced turkey bacon instead of bacon bits and added a heaping teaspoon of Bacon Jam for good measure. For the meat, I took the advice of reviewers and added spices including garlic powder, onion powder, a little "sopping sauce" and Adams House Seasoning. The time given was perfect! Best Meatloaf Ever!

This is a great recipe. I did add a few things based upon the comments BUT I think that it would still be good as is...so 5 stars. My additions were to add a pound of ground sausage, use Italian Bread Crumbs and no crackers, fry a half of a pound of bacon and then saute' a whole onion and 1/2 of a bell pepper in the bacon grease. I reserved some of the bacon for the topping and added the rest to the meat mixture. Because I doubled the meat, I doubled all of the ingredients... plus more garlic and a shot of Texas Pete's Hot Sauce. I used a 8oz can of crushed pineapple and didn't drain it at all...just used the whole thing! I made mini meatloaves so that I could freeze them for later. (There are only two of us!) Super yummy! Thanks for sharing!

I did add some extra seasoning because I was worried it would be bland after reading some reviews and looking at the recipe. I added a few tablespoons of bbq sauce in the meat mixture, some extra pineapple, some ground chipotle powder and some salt & pepper. That made a huge difference and gave it a nice subtle kick. I also added the chipotle powder to the glaze mixture. Another trick that I adapted from another recipe was instead of using the crackers/bread crumbs, I took some garlic croutons and pulsed them in the food processor until they were coarse crumbs. I will definitely use this recipe again!

Yes I will make this again. It was delicious. Added salt and pepper in with the meat. Ran out of ketchup for the glaze so I used honey BBQ sauce, teriyaki sauce a dash of soy and Worcestershire sauce. Made the sauce caramelize on top of the meatloaf!
Made the sauce as per recipe. Meatloaf added diced green peppers and seasoning's garlic powder, salt, pepper, thyme and worcestershire. was really enjoyable meal. Very easy to make.

I had been lokking for a new Meatloaf recipe that was not boring. This recipe was amazing..

I did make a few changes.. I used 1/2 Turkey burger + 1/2 spicy pork sausage to mix it up a bit.

I have made this several times and usually make 2 so I can freeze one and bake it later. 

This is our go to Meatloaf recipe now.

I love this recipe. Instead of using saltine crackers I use butter crackers. I dice a whole onion and add it. I use ground venison instead of beef. I’m going to make it today and add in a chopped jalapeño and either cheddar cheese or goat cheese. Yum!!!

This was very flavorful and good, but I don't know if I would rank it "the best". However, it is definitely approved by a 5 year old; my husband said the meat was good, but the topping was a little too sweet for him. Here's a small tip for anyone who is in a hurry...instead of preparing the topping first, start by preparing the meat first, so that while the meat is in the oven for 30 min, THEN you can be multi-tasking and mixing the topping. It saved me several minutes! Also, I think that next time, I would put the bacon in the meat, rather than on top. The flavor of the bacon got completely lost in all of the sweetness. Overall it was a fun little recipe to try. Thanks!
The only change I made was that I had 1/2 a cup of chopped bacon, so added 1/4 cup to the meatloaf and the other 1/4 cup to the glaze. Very tasty! Thanks for sharing this recipe!

I make what I consider a darn good meatloaf, but when I saw this recipe I had to try it. Not only is the meatloaf itself very good the pineapple sauce on top takes it up a notch. The sauce may be to sweet for some but I liked it as written.
This was an easy recipie which came out very good. It did not require any changes.
We followed this recipe exactly and it was delicious! Added to our most favorite meals. Thank you for sharing this recipe!!
I like the brown sugar meatloaf better.
4.5 stars for the topping. I used my own spice blend and added chopped green pepper to the meat mixture. Doubled the ground beef for a larger meatloaf, thus increased all of the ingredients.
It is so good , love this one.
Delicious! Especially the pineapple topping. I used chili sauce instead of ketchup.
Double batch and didn't make it past one day!! Second and thirds
The title says it all. I thought I made the best meatloaf but this surpasses mine! Wonderful flavor. I have served it twice to guests...
